interventions.demand_shift: at generation multiply physical zone 0 population by U[1.65,2.20] and others by U[0.85,1.05]
interventions.longer_travel_lags: at generation multiply every reachable route mean and derived standard deviation by 1.75
interventions.route_closure_cascade: at t=3 close deterministic SHA-ranked first ceiling(35%) of initially reachable routes
interventions.shelter_failure: at t=3 close the initially highest-capacity shelter; canonical ID breaks ties
interventions.sudden_flood_surge: at t=3 add 0.18 zone and 0.10 shelter severity, clipped at 1
